title: Lint finding
description: One finding of a lint run, one line of <venture>/.naive/lint-findings.jsonl, the log every lint appends to whatever the finding's severity (packages/naive/src/engine/lint-findings.ts). lint says which lint wrote it: publish (packages/naive/src/engine/publish-lint.ts, a page's copy), artifact (packages/naive/src/checks/artifact-lint.ts, an artifact against its declared type, EE-231) or role (packages/naive/src/checks/role-program.ts, a role's program of checks on what it makes, EE-237). A line with no lint was written by the publish lint before the field existed. naive lint report aggregates the log by rule, role or harness.

at.description: When the run that found it started; one run's lines share it

lint.description: The lint that wrote the line

rule.description: The rule's id within its lint

family.description: An artifact or role lint rule's family: a protocol rule is always an error; an artifact lint design rule is off, warn or error under artifact_lint.rules in naive.config.json

severity.description: The level the rule had when it ran; a rule set off writes nothing

artifact.description: The artifact linted, as a logical path in the venture (artifact lint)

kind.description: The type the artifact claims: a document kind in packages/naive/src/functions/documents.json or a record type in the data model (artifact lint)

role.description: The role that made the artifact, when it is known; for the role lint, the role whose program ran

harness.description: The harness adapter that rendered the artifact, when it is known

file.description: The file whose copy was linted (publish lint)

field.description: The field of a JSON record the copy came from (publish lint)

line.description: The line the copy sits on (publish lint)

published.description: The file was already published (publish lint)

waived.description: A person waived the finding under publish_lint.waived (publish lint)
